name: Split the Bill
description: Split a bill evenly with tip and rounding, or work out who owes whom after a trip.
prompt: A bill splitter with two modes: split evenly with people, tip and rounding up, or enter how much each person paid and it tells who pays whom to settle up, with a share button.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Divide una cuenta a partes iguales con propina y redondeo, o calcula quién debe a quién después de un viaje.
